abbrev_name.desc: Abbreviated name for the driver, used when character space is limited

team_name.desc: Name of the team that the participant represents

vehicle_number.desc: Car number of the participant (not necessarily unique if multiple players drive same car)

vehicle_id.desc: Id of the vehicle that this participant uses

in_current_session.desc: True if participant is part of the currently active session

on_track.desc: Participant is currently on the track (or on pitlane). false, if participant is inside pitbox

tire_id.desc: Id of the tire compound currently used. Used as default when per-wheel tire ids are not specified
